cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Directly uses ZipEntry name to construct file path without validation, allowing path traversal via '../' sequences in ZIP entry names
Creates directories based on potentially malicious ZipEntry names, enabling directory traversal attacks
Creates parent directories for files extracted from ZIP without validating path traversal sequences
Writes file content to potentially malicious path constructed from untrusted ZipEntry name
